attribution: External conventional bank and native bank/selectors differ. No isolated geometry effect.
cohort: Single-invocation endpoints with extra search; not a new Table II in-flow experiment.
coverage_policy: Retain every expected endpoint. Failed proofs or physical runs are coverage failures; do not replace unknown physical metrics with zero gain.
first_setup_attempt: Retained externally: missing sibling Liberty gzip stopped the initial attempt at mapping validation. Repaired packaging; no physical setting or endpoint was selected by that failure.

machine.cpu_model: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

power: OpenROAD/OpenSTA default activity, without workload VCD.
proof_policy: Common input -> optimized endpoint -> actual ORFS mapped function -> final netlist, by successful CEC and hash links. Verdict excerpts are evidence records, not standalone SAT certificates.
runtime: flow_stage_wall_s covers synthesis/floorplanning and the placement-to-finish flow, excluding separate CEC. Multiplying by reserved cores estimates reservation cost, not measured CPU use. driver wall_s includes proof and wrapper costs; the recovered sqrt row also includes recovery wait.
statistical_policy: 100*(1-geometric_mean(candidate/reference)); paired design bootstrap, seed 20261116, 5000 replicates. No selection using OpenROAD metrics.
